items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Noone was working at -- working upstairs, and we were downstairs.

ctx.x: Was anybody the leader of the singing, in particular, or did they just come up that way?
Yes. Yes, yes. That's -- I'm glad you asked me. For instance, you, Herman, Joe, Jim, they had their particular song that they did, that couldn't nobody else duplicate.
